name: MARIO-10M
description: MARIO-10M is a large-scale dataset of 10 million image-text pairs with OCR annotations for text recognition, detection, and character-level segmentation. It supports training and evaluation of models generating images with visually coherent and accurate text. The MARIO-Eval benchmark is introduced for comprehensive evaluation of text rendering quality.
reputation: A recent large-scale multimodal text-rendering dataset/benchmark that is relevant for OCR-aware image generation and has emerging interest in the vision-language community.
notes: First large-scale text images dataset with OCR annotations; includes MARIO-Eval benchmark for text rendering quality; supports text inpainting and layout generation.
